constraints.label: Locked objects
constraints.remediation: Remove Changes that target protected venue objects.

constraints.label: Accessible route
constraints.remediation: Connect every required destination and increase the minimum clear route width.

constraints.label: Turning clearance
constraints.remediation: Increase the clear turning diameter at route junctions.

constraints.label: Accessible seating
constraints.remediation: Add distributed accessible and companion seating positions.

constraints.label: Accessible seating sightlines
constraints.remediation: Move obstructions or relocate accessible seating samples until every section has a clear focal-point ray.

constraints.label: Door clearance
constraints.remediation: Clear the maneuvering zone and restore the required accessible door width.

constraints.label: Temporary ramps
constraints.remediation: Increase ramp run, clear width, landing, or edge protection and add required handrails.

constraints.label: Capacity
constraints.remediation: Restore sufficient placed capacity or reduce the operational load.

constraints.label: Sightline coverage
constraints.remediation: Move opaque obstructions or revise the seating section.

constraints.label: Production readiness
constraints.remediation: Resolve throw, visibility, audio, camera, cable, circuit, rigging, or inventory failures.

constraints.label: Catering readiness
constraints.remediation: Resolve service capacity, queue, separation, access, support, or replenishment failures.

constraints.label: Emergency readiness
constraints.remediation: Restore exit, assembly, emergency access, fire equipment, first-aid, and command-post readiness.

constraints.label: Peak congestion
constraints.remediation: Increase circulation width, reconnect occupied zones, or reduce phase demand.

details.goal: Keep 400 seats, widen the center aisle to six feet, improve sightlines, and preserve locked objects.
